title: Ortho Home Defense Insect Killer for Indoor and Perimeter2 with Comfort Wand - Ready-To-Use Bug Spray, Kills Ants, Cockroaches & Spiders, 1.33 gal.

reviews.title: Easy to use and effective
reviews.body: I have bought two of these. One for my own place and one for my parents  place. There is plenty of solution so this will last a long time. I bought this originally because I had a flea infestation that all natural remedies had not taken care of and I wanted to make sure it wouldn't be toxic to my cat or anyone else. The wand makes it easy to spray and cover large swathes of area without your finger getting tired. Just be aware if you are spraying upwards to maybe wear eye protection and a mask so that you don't accidentally ingest or absorb any of it just in case. The bugs in my area are very stubborn so I did have to reapply after a month but after two applications, I didn't see any bugs until a year later. I am sure if I reapplied, it would have worked for another year. I definitely recommend as it seems to really have helped with the presence of bugs and once dried, I don't have to worry about the chemicals. I've lent it out to friends to use and it seems to work just as well or better for others.I highly recommend this with the wand since it makes application so much easier.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on June 2, 2026
reviews.author: Tia c.

reviews.title: Effective and easy to use! A must buy for pest problems!
reviews.body: I don’t normally leave product reviews, but I felt compelled to for this home pest spray. I was genuinely surprised how easy to use and effective this sprayer was. My house was infested with black widows, spiders, and large cockroaches that would leave tons webs and eggs all over the property. After reading reviews, I decided to try this ortho spray. It was very easy to use and apply throughout the property. A few days later, I found tons of dead bugs near the areas where I had spray. Not only had it effectively killed these pests, it also effectively kept them away from my house. I haven’t noticed any new webs, insects, or eggs around the house. I highly recommend this to everyone. Way cheaper than pest services and works great for its purpose.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on June 18, 2026
reviews.author: Indigo

reviews.title: I love this stuff
reviews.body: It helps with ants .  It kills them instantly.  I never see it leak.  It has 3 ways to turn it off.  You turn it off where the wand connects.  You can turn the wand to off and you can shut the trigger off.  I sprayed the outside of my house with it.  You don't smell it or see it after it dries.  I think it is a great value and very effective at keeping ants away.

reviews.author: Hard Rock Girl

reviews.title: Finding a remedy to a disgusting problem
reviews.body: When I moved into my new place I found out that I had extra gifts spending the night evidently, critters called roaches.  The stuff that the property uses clearly does nothing whatsoever.  So now I'm on a quest to find the best thing that I can to get rid of these disgusting things.This spray doesn't kill on contact but it kills after they keep walking through where it's been spraying, if I'm understanding correctly.  After week I took everything out after the initial spray and sprayed the area again, placing everything back in the cabinets after it had been washed wiped down etc.  so far all I'm seeing is a few roaches with a few babies.  Which I guess I'm going to have to take everything out again and respray everything down since it is better than when I first moved in the first night.So so far I am more pleased than when I first moved in and considering the dead bugs I'm finding when I go in after a week to vacuum and clean everything out, I am thinking that I'm going to be pretty happy with this.The sprayer that comes with it is convenient and makes it super easy without having to do contortions to reach the top of cabinets.  It also doesn't seem to have any negative odor that I have found.So so far so good and I would recommend it.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on May 17, 2026
reviews.author: Rene

reviews.title: My Go-To for Keeping Roaches Out
reviews.body: Every year when the weather starts heating up outside, the roaches seem to try making their way into the house. I've been using Home Defense Insect Killer to spray the perimeter of our home, and it has become part of my regular routine.After spraying, we might see one or two dead roaches inside the house over the next few days, but after that, nothing. It does a great job creating a barrier and stopping them before they become a bigger problem.What I like most is how cost-effective it is. It's way cheaper than paying for regular pest control service, and I've had great results handling the problem myself. One bottle goes a long way and helps keep the bugs where they belong—outside.I've used this product multiple times over the years with consistent results. Highly recommended and definitely a 5-star product in my experience.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on June 24, 2026
reviews.author: _.EfraiN._

reviews.title: Works great
reviews.body: I sprayed this around the exterior of my house, including around windows. I was smashing multiple earwigs daily in my house before. I had even found three cockroaches inside within about a 2-week span. It seems to be a bad year for pests. But now I've only found one earwig inside and no cockroaches in the 5 weeks or so since spraying this. The wand is very handy and easy to use, and one of these containers was a good amount to thoroughly do the outside of my house.Way more affordable than hiring a pest service, effective, and easy!
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on June 27, 2026
reviews.author: KeatonGuano

reviews.title: Repeat buyer
reviews.body: I buy this product about once a year to spray inside and outside my house. We live in a rural wooded area, and for those who do not live or spend time in the country, we have lots of bugs around. I rarely see a bug in my house and only dead ones on the porch. This spray is legit. If it works in the middle of the woods it will keep your place bug free anywhere.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on June 21, 2026
reviews.author: Jessica

reviews.title: Works great
reviews.body: This stuff works great and the little handle sprayer is easy to use and very precise. I got this to treat my house in between terminex visits and it does great! No more spiders or ants or other pesky bugs. I reapply it about once every two weeks or if I see any bugs I spray and they go away! I haven’t used it outside only in the house.

features: WHERE TO USE INSECT SPRAY: Use this pest control spray indoors in kitchens and bathrooms or around doors and windows, and outdoors to the perimeter of foundations, patios, decks, garages or wherever insects are a recurring problem

LONG-LASTING PROTECTION: This outdoor perimeter and indoor bug spray for homes creates a bug barrier that provides up to 12 month protection against ants, roaches and spiders when applied indoors on non-porous surfaces

EASY-TO-USE APPLICATOR: This 1.33 gal. container of Ortho Home Defense Insect Killer for Indoor & Perimeter2 Ready-To-Use comes with a battery-powered Comfort Wand sprayer, which delivers a continuous spray for easy application

INDOOR INSECT KILLER: Ortho Home Defense Insect Killer for Indoor & Perimeter2 is a bug killer spray that kills the toughest home-invading insects, including ants, cockroaches, spiders, fleas, ticks, scorpions, earwigs, silverfish, and more as listed
WHEN TO USE: Apply this bug spray outdoors or indoors anytime as a preventative treatment or after you see evidence of insect activity
